name: afterclip
description: Clip game moments with hotkeys or Stream Deck, powered by libobs

scripts.build:engine: node scripts/fetch-obs.js && node scripts/build-engine.js && node scripts/build-plugin.js
scripts.plugin: node scripts/build-plugin.js && npx -y @elgato/cli@1.10.4 pack streamdeck/com.afterclip.clips.sdPlugin --output streamdeck/dist --force --no-update-check
scripts.brand: node scripts/build-brand.js && tauri icon branding/afterclip-icon-1024.png -o src-tauri/icons
